verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, and both are unusable. The barrel photo, the design's key image, has shrunk to a tiny thumbnail next to an equally tiny logo at the far right. The small em-dash divider has been stretched into a heavy black bar under the headline. The torn-paper texture floats on its own as a meaningless patch, the tagline sits apart from the headline, and the canvas is mostly empty white, so nothing of the original's feel survives.
